title: cpictl XSLT test case
description: A test of an XSLT mapping stored in the Partner Directory: .cpi/tests/pd/<PID>/<ID>/<case>.yaml tests the binary parameter <PID>/<ID>, run with cpictl test xslt. See docs/testing.md (XSLT mappings).

description.title: Description
examples: Maps an order with two items

order.title: Order
order.description: Sorts the cases of a parameter (lower first, then by file name).

xslt.title: Stylesheet
xslt.description: Stylesheet file relative to the case file; default the Partner Directory file <pd-dir>/<PID>/Binary/<ID>.xsl (or .xslt) of pd-snapshot.

input_file.title: Input file
input_file.description: File with the message body, relative to the case file.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Message headers, passed as stylesheet parameters (xsl:param).

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Exchange properties, passed as stylesheet parameters (xsl:param). A name may not be both a header and a property.

stringOrList.description: A string or a list of strings.

expect.description: The expected outcome; every expectation that is set must hold. With error_contains the transformation must fail; otherwise it must succeed.

output.title: Output
output.description: Expected output: compared as XML (attribute order, whitespace between elements, comments and the XML declaration do not count), as trimmed text when it is not XML.

output_file.title: Output file
output_file.description: File with the expected output, relative to the case file.

output_not_contains.title: Output does not contain
output_not_contains.description: Texts the output does not contain.

output_xpath.title: Output XPath
output_xpath.description: Path (/a/b, //name, [@attr='v'], /@attr, /text()) -> expected text of the first match.

error_contains.title: Error contains
error_contains.description: The transformation fails and its error contains these texts.
